idx_digest_ledger_anchor_status.sql:

idx_digest_ledger_journal_anchor.sql:

idx_eal_entity_agent.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_eal_entity_agent ON entity_access_log(entity_id, agent)

idx_entities_workflow_state.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_entities_workflow_state ON entities(type, workflow_state)

idx_extraction_runs_source.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_extraction_runs_source ON extraction_runs(source_uri, content_hash)

idx_imprint_proposals_committed_at.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_imprint_proposals_committed_at

idx_imprint_proposals_status_expires.sql:

idx_seat_claims_seat.sql:

            ON seat_claims (seat, status)

idx_session_journals_session_id_unique.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_session_journals_session_id_unique
    ON session_journals(session_id)
    WHERE session_id IS NOT NULL

idx_v3_sf_cache.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_v3_sf_cache ON surface_forms(mention, context_hash)

assertions.sql:
CREATE TABLE "assertions" (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            entity_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES entities(id),
            claim TEXT NOT NULL,
            confidence TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'believed',
            confidence_score REAL,
            evidence TEXT,
            evidence_uris TEXT,
            derivation_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inference',
            chunk_id TEXT,
            chunk_id_schema TEXT,
            reasoning_summary TEXT,
            extraction_run INTEGER,
            is_atomic BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
            is_decontextualized BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
            observed_at DATETIME,
            valid_from DATETIME,
            valid_until DATETIME,
            superseded_by INTEGER REFERENCES "assertions"(id),
            review_status TEXT DEFAULT 'committed',
            reviewer TEXT,
            reviewed_at DATETIME,
            review_notes TEXT,
            created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            seeded_by TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
            claim_hash TEXT,
            resolution_status TEXT
                CHECK(resolution_status IN ('pending', 'fulfilled', 'breached', 'unknown')),
            fulfillment_assertion_id INTEGER REFERENCES "assertions"(id),
            quality_score REAL,
            supersession_scope TEXT DEFAULT 'local',
            prospective_summary TEXT,
            events_json TEXT,
            artifact_uri TEXT,
            artifact_storage TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inline',
            entrenchment_score REAL,
            predicate_form TEXT,
            raw_predicate_form TEXT,
            normalization_decision TEXT,
            candidate_set_fingerprint TEXT,
            normalizer_version TEXT
        , credibility TEXT, attributes TEXT)

assertions_fts.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE assertions_fts USING fts5(  indexed_text,  assertion_id UNINDEXED,  entity_id UNINDEXED,  tokenize='porter unicode61')

assertions_fts_config.sql: CREATE TABLE 'assertions_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID

assertions_fts_content.sql: CREATE TABLE 'assertions_fts_content'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c0, c1, c2)

assertions_fts_data.sql: CREATE TABLE 'assertions_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)

assertions_fts_docsize.sql: CREATE TABLE 'assertions_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)

assertions_fts_idx.sql: CREATE TABLE 'assertions_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

chunks.sql:
CREATE TABLE chunks (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_date DATETIME,
    observer TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'web-claude',
    chunk_index INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    extraction_run INTEGER,
    token_count INTEGER,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
, source_hash TEXT, model_version TEXT, pinpoint TEXT)

close_drafts.sql:
CREATE TABLE close_drafts (
            session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            agent TEXT NOT NULL,
            revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            fields TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            check_state TEXT,
            ttl_expires_at TEXT,
            reflection_flush_after TEXT,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            committed_at TEXT
        )

digest_jobs.sql:
CREATE TABLE digest_jobs (
            job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'extract',
            journal_entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            journal_uri TEXT,
            entry_anchor TEXT NOT NULL,
            entry_text TEXT NOT NULL,
            content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            prompt_rev TEXT NOT NULL,
            prompt_sha256 TEXT,
            prompt_uri TEXT,
            model TEXT NOT NULL,
            lane TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cowork',
            execution_id TEXT,
            archive_uri TEXT,
            harvest_sha256 TEXT,
            claims_json TEXT,
            verify_verdicts TEXT,
            staging_batch_id TEXT,
            state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ENQUEUED',
            attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            last_error TEXT,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))
        )

digest_ledger.sql:
CREATE TABLE digest_ledger (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            journal_entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            entry_anchor TEXT NOT NULL,
            content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            emitted_ids TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            staging_batch_id TEXT,
            verify_verdicts TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))
        , revision_of INTEGER, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'committed', superseded_ids TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', retracted_ids TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', carried_forward_ids TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', snapshot_uri TEXT)

dream_state_cursor.sql:
CREATE TABLE dream_state_cursor (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            last_processed_id INTEGER,
            run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            completed_at TEXT,
            pipeline_version TEXT NOT NULL,
            assertions_processed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            actions_taken INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        )

entities.sql:
CREATE TABLE entities (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    type TEXT NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    notes TEXT,
    aliases TEXT,
    attributes TEXT,
    source_uri TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
, content_hash TEXT, retention_policy TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'permanent', retention_ttl_days INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, last_accessed_at TEXT DEFAULT NULL, workflow_state TEXT, lifecycle TEXT, confidence_band TEXT, confidence_score REAL, adoption TEXT)

entity_access_log.sql:
CREATE TABLE entity_access_log (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  agent TEXT NOT NULL,
  operation TEXT NOT NULL,
  source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'agent',
  session_id TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)

entity_access_summary.sql:
CREATE TABLE entity_access_summary (
  entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  agent TEXT NOT NULL,
  week_start TEXT NOT NULL,
  agent_access_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  boot_access_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  session_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (entity_id, agent, week_start)
)

entity_aliases.sql:
CREATE TABLE entity_aliases (
            entity_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES entities(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            alias TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
            PRIMARY KEY (entity_id, alias)
        )

entity_salience_cache.sql:
CREATE TABLE entity_salience_cache (
  entity_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES entities(id),
  salience_score REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
  temporal_score REAL,
  structural_score REAL,
  contextual_score REAL,
  frequency_score REAL,
  fast_state_hash TEXT,
  slow_state_hash TEXT,
  last_surprise REAL,
  fingerprint TEXT,
  computed_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  boot_section_cache TEXT
)

event_chain_members.sql:
CREATE TABLE event_chain_members (
  chain_id INTEGER REFERENCES event_chains(id),
  event_id TEXT REFERENCES entities(id),
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (chain_id, event_id)
)

event_chains.sql:
CREATE TABLE event_chains (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  chain_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  root_event_id TEXT REFERENCES entities(id),
  domain TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)

extraction_runs.sql:
CREATE TABLE extraction_runs (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    source_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running',
    model TEXT NOT NULL,
    chunk_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    entity_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    assertion_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    surface_form_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    error_log TEXT,
    started_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    completed_at DATETIME,
    duration_ms INTEGER,
    content_hash TEXT
)

extraction_staging.sql:
CREATE TABLE extraction_staging (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    source_uri TEXT,
    proposal_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(proposal_type IN ('entity', 'assertion')),
    proposal_action TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'add'
        CHECK(proposal_action IN ('add', 'revise', 'remove')),
    target_id TEXT,
    proposal_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    chunk_id INTEGER REFERENCES chunks(id),
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
        CHECK(status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'merged')),
    resolved_to TEXT,
    reviewer TEXT,
    reviewed_at TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)

imprint_proposals.sql:
CREATE TABLE imprint_proposals (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            normalized_patch TEXT NOT NULL,
            op_plan TEXT NOT NULL,
            rejects TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            candidates TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            committed_at TEXT
        , patch_sha256 TEXT, applied_result TEXT)

journal_links.sql:
CREATE TABLE journal_links (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                from_entry INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES reflective_journal(id),
                to_entry INTEGER REFERENCES reflective_journal(id),
                to_entity TEXT,
                link_type TEXT NOT NULL
                    CHECK (link_type IN (
                        'contradicts', 'refines', 'supersedes', 'reopens',
                        'unresolved_with', 'continues', 'related', 'handoff_for'
                    )),
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),
                CHECK (to_entry IS NOT NULL OR to_entity IS NOT NULL)
            )

near_duplicate_flags.sql:
CREATE TABLE near_duplicate_flags (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    assertion_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES assertions(id),
    duplicate_of INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES assertions(id),
    score REAL NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))
)

reflective_journal.sql:
CREATE TABLE reflective_journal (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                agent TEXT NOT NULL,
                register TEXT NOT NULL,
                entry TEXT NOT NULL,
                kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'entry'
                    CHECK (kind IN (
                        'entry', 'reflection', 'revision', 'consolidation', 'handoff'
                    )),
                session_id TEXT,
                revises INTEGER REFERENCES reflective_journal(id),
                consolidation_data TEXT,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))
            )

relationship_types.sql:
CREATE TABLE relationship_types (
    type TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    description TEXT,
    inverse TEXT REFERENCES relationship_types(type),
    is_transitive BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    is_symmetric BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    from_type TEXT,
    to_type TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)

relationships.sql:
CREATE TABLE "relationships" (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            type TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES relationship_types(type),
            from_entity TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES entities(id),
            to_entity TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES entities(id),
            role TEXT,
            strength REAL DEFAULT 1.0,
            evidence TEXT,
            chunk_id INTEGER,
            valid_from DATETIME,
            valid_until DATETIME,
            source_uri TEXT,
            created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            superseded_by INTEGER REFERENCES "relationships"(id),
            session_id TEXT,
            agent TEXT
        )

schema_version.sql:
CREATE TABLE schema_version (
    version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    applied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    description TEXT
)

seat_claims.sql:
CREATE TABLE seat_claims (
            id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            claim_key         TEXT NOT NULL,
            seat              TEXT NOT NULL,
            holder_id         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            status            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('held','released','reclaimed')),
            claimed_at        TEXT NOT NULL,
            last_heartbeat_at TEXT,
            ttl_s             REAL NOT NULL,
            ended_at          TEXT,
            end_reason        TEXT,
            metadata          TEXT
        )

session_edge_types.sql:
CREATE TABLE session_edge_types (
    type        TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
    description TEXT    NOT NULL,
    directional BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE
)

session_edges.sql:
CREATE TABLE session_edges (
    id          INTEGER     PRIMARY KEY,
    session_id  TEXT        NOT NULL,
    agent       TEXT        NOT NULL,
    from_node   TEXT        NOT NULL,
    to_node     TEXT        NOT NULL,
    edge_type   TEXT        NOT NULL    REFERENCES session_edge_types(type),
    strength    REAL        NOT NULL    DEFAULT 0.8
                            CHECK (strength >= 0.0 AND strength <= 1.0),
    edge_source TEXT        NOT NULL    DEFAULT 'explicit',
    context     TEXT,
    prompt      TEXT,
    seeded_by   TEXT,
    valid_until TIMESTAMP,
    metadata    TEXT,
    created_at  TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL    DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)

session_journals.sql:
CREATE TABLE session_journals (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
    agent TEXT NOT NULL,
    summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    domains TEXT,
    decisions TEXT,
    open_items TEXT,
    file_path TEXT
, entity_ids TEXT DEFAULT '[]', session_id TEXT, prior_session_id TEXT, handoff_prompt TEXT, source_ref TEXT)

surface_forms.sql:
CREATE TABLE "surface_forms" (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            mention TEXT NOT NULL,
            entity_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES entities(id),
            chunk_id INTEGER,
            resolution_confidence REAL,
            resolution_reasoning TEXT,
            context_hash TEXT,
            mention_type TEXT DEFAULT 'name',
            created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        )

tag_assignments.sql:
CREATE TABLE tag_assignments (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            tag_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            assertion_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            assigned_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
            assigned_by TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(tag_name, entity_id),
            FOREIGN KEY (entity_id) REFERENCES entities(id),
            FOREIGN KEY (assertion_id) REFERENCES assertions(id)
        )

type_attribute_schemas.sql: CREATE TABLE type_attribute_schemas (  entity_type        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,  required_keys      TEXT NOT NULL,  optional_keys      TEXT NOT NULL,  enum_constraints   TEXT NOT NULL,  notes              TEXT)

type_confidence_fields.sql: CREATE TABLE type_confidence_fields (  entity_type      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,  confidence_field TEXT NOT NULL)

workflow_schemas.sql: CREATE TABLE workflow_schemas (  entity_type    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,  enum_values    TEXT NOT NULL,  initial_state  TEXT NOT NULL,  terminal_states TEXT,  notes          TEXT, closure_audit_exempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
